checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Output contains full original 10-second kitchen-table video, unaltered
must.why: Only a 15 s WAV music track was delivered; no video output was produced.

must.item: Added music clearly audible, warm, hopeful, gentle
must.why: A 15 s WAV with sound exists, but it is not mixed into any video and its character cannot be judged.

must.item: Woman's spoken introduction remains audible throughout
must.why: No video was delivered, so the speech is not in the output.

must.item: Music ends with the video rather than running over extra footage
must.why: The track is 15 s against a 10 s clip and it is not trimmed or combined.

faults.what: No video with music was delivered; the user asked to add music to the clip and only got a separate audio file.
The track is 15 s, longer than the 10 s clip, and the user must trim it themselves.
The user has to mix the track in an editor.

summary: The agent delivered only a separate 15 s music WAV and not the clip with music added, so the request was not fulfilled, though it said so clearly and the track may suit the mood.
